verdict.rationale: Gemini API documents first-party webhooks that push real-time notifications to your server when long-running operations finish, covering Batch jobs, Interactions and video generation. A full WebhookService REST reference (create, ping, rotateSigningSecret, list, get, update, delete) means consumers can register and manage subscriptions programmatically. missing for 10: general-availability status (the feature is marked preview), independent or hands-on corroboration of delivery reliability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Webhooks allow the Gemini API to push real-time notifications to your server when asynchronous or Long-Running Operations (LROs) complete.
A full WebhookService REST reference exists (create, ping, rotateSigningSecret, list, get, update, delete).
